example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গন্ধেগন্ধে ঠিক জায়গায় পৌঁছে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The police caught the criminal by following the clues step by step.
He arrived at the exact spot by tracking the trail meticulously.
note: This idiom draws from the natural instinct of following scents, common in rural or tracking contexts in Bengali folklore.
